headline: Discovering Newtown, Connecticut This Fall
subhead: Explore scenic trails, historic Main Street, and lakeside parks across town.
caption: October brings crisp air and vibrant autumn colors to Newtown. From the historic flagpole on Main Street and the grounds of Edmond Town Hall to the expansive walking paths at Fairfield Hills, there is plenty of open space to enjoy. Outdoor recreation options include hiking at Holcombe Hill Wildlife Preserve, exploring trails in Paugussett State Forest, and accessing boating areas along Lake Zoar and Lake Lillinonah. Downtown features independent restaurants, local shops, and cultural gatherings throughout the fall season. Route 25 and Interstate 84 provide regional connections across Fairfield County and beyond. If you are exploring a move to Newtown, reach out today to discuss current real estate opportunities.
